name: John S. Lane
milestones: Granted a land warrant in 1851 for service in the Missouri Volunteers, probably in Indian or Mormon conflicts.
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Father of Cynthia Lane. His 1851 land warrant in Chariton County, Missouri, included the parcel later patented by George Francis Adams (#1).
Listed in Index of Names under LANE, page 3, no dates [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 5878]
